$sources: Measures and colours: the as-built museum's lily colonies (windows/Source/MuseeVision/Nature/MuseeWaterLilies.cpp, BuildWaterLilies and AddNymphaea), which the owner approved.
The cultivar: Joseph Bory Latour-Marliac's hardy hybrid 'Marliacea Albida' (Temple-sur-Lot, 1880s), white with a faint blush; Latour-Marliac was Monet's supplier from 1894.
Ranges for hardy Nymphaea: pads 15-30 cm across, flowers 10-15 cm (P. D. Slocum, Waterlilies and Lotuses, Timber Press 2005). To confirm against Slocum's entry for the cultivar.
name: Nymphaea × marliacea 'Albida'
note: White, a blush at the tips.
